signals.label: Large-site readiness, access, and hazard fit

signals.label: Municipality restaurant activity baseline
interpretationLimits: The CBP row is descriptive business-activity context and not a demand, profitability, or market-size measure.
This source covers only the fixed municipality/category slice and does not prove corridor or island-wide customer pull.

signals.label: Expanded reach demand proxies beyond one municipality
interpretationLimits: No registered corridor or island-wide spending, visitor, or traffic proxy is attached to the matrix.
The current matrix cannot separate observed local category presence from broader reachable demand.
signals.sourceGapBasis: Demand expansion beyond the fixed municipality remains blocked on a registered Puerto Rico demand-proxy source.

signals.label: Aguada electric and water service continuity baseline
interpretationLimits: The reviewed sources establish official rate and interruption-handling surfaces, not measured outage frequency or restoration duration for one address.
The current baseline still does not quantify refrigeration-loss exposure, backup-power coverage, or small-business utility costs for a specific lease.

signals.label: Utility resilience and operating continuity at larger scales
interpretationLimits: No registered evidence covers corridor-level or island-wide utility redundancy, outage recovery, or resilience cost.
The matrix cannot yet distinguish ordinary service adequacy from backup-power or resilience requirements.
signals.sourceGapBasis: Larger-scale infrastructure resilience remains an explicit source gap.

signals.label: Routine service-role staffing depth
interpretationLimits: The current higher-education artifacts are not occupation-specific labor-supply evidence for restaurant staffing.
No registered wage, commute-time, or hiring-competition source is tied to the fixed selection.
signals.sourceGapBasis: Workforce depth for food-service roles remains blocked on a registered occupation-level labor source.

signals.label: Specialized management and multi-site workforce pipeline
interpretationLimits: No registered workforce source measures island-wide management depth, supervisory hiring competition, or retention risk.
Institution-location artifacts remain corroboration material rather than workforce-capacity evidence.
signals.sourceGapBasis: Strategic-scale workforce coverage remains blocked on an occupation and skill pipeline source.

signals.label: Routine local supplier and delivery access

interpretationLimits: No registered evidence covers corridor-level route reliability or temperature-sensitive supplier exposure.

interpretationLimits: No registered port, airport, or freight source is tied into the current fixed-selection matrix.
